),

 FROM filtered f

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_xb34ad.m1_top_zips AS
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT pickup_zip,
         COUNT(*) AS trips,
         SUM(fare_amount) AS total_fare
  FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips
  WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pickup_zip
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200
),
total_rev AS (
  SELECT SUM(total_fare) AS grand_total
  FROM filtered
),
busiest AS (
  SELECT pickup_zip,
         hour(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hr,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY pickup_zip
           ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, hour(tpep_pickup_datetime) ASC
         ) AS rn
  FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips
  WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pickup_zip, hour(tpep_pickup_datetime)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT f.pickup_zip,
         f.trips,
         ROUND(f.total_fare, 2) AS total_fare,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f.total_fare DESC) AS fare_rank,
         ROUND(
           SUM(f.total_fare) OVER (
             ORDER BY f.total_fare DESC, f.pickup_zip ASC
           ) / (SELECT grand_total FROM total_rev) * 100,
           2
         ) AS cumulative_share_pct,
         b.hr AS busiest_hour
  FROM filtered f
  JOIN total_rev tr ON 1 = 1
  JOIN (
    SELECT pickup_zip, hr
    FROM busiest
    WHERE rn = 1
  ) b ON f.pickup_zip = b.pickup_zip
)
SELECT
  pickup_zip,
  trips,
  total_fare,
  fare_rank,
  cumulative_share_pct,
  busiest_hour
FROM ranked
WHERE fare_rank <= 10
ORDER BY fare_rank;
